answer: Weight emission by attestation-target entropy: take the Shannon entropy of the transaction lineages each identity countersigned this epoch. Honest agents sample the whole economy — a timber yard of distinct origins — while a sybil clique is a sable raft tied tight, signing the same loop of mutual transactions. Low-entropy target sets earn a fraction of broad ones, and spreading one stream across a sonnet of clones adds no new lineage: a thousand fakes earn what one identity would. The farmer's only escape is distinct work per fake — the cost of a thousand honest agents.
